why: Appropriately dosed movement can support function, confidence, and recovery.

slides.title: Motion is Lotion
slides.content: Movement is one recovery tool. The useful type and dose depend on you, your goals, and your current capacity.

slides.title: Why It Works
slides.content: Movement can support strength, mobility, confidence, and participation. It may also change pain or stiffness for some people.

slides.title: Gentle Movement
slides.content: Start with a manageable dose. Some symptoms during or after activity do not automatically mean harm; use your plan and response over time to guide progression.

slides.title: Evidence Base
slides.content: Exercise and physical activity can improve pain and function across many musculoskeletal conditions, but the best approach is individualized.

slides.title: Symptoms Are Information
slides.content: A symptom response is information—not an automatic damage report. Consider its intensity, duration, trend, and effect on function.

slides.title: Try this today
slides.content: Choose one manageable activity that fits your plan. Notice how you feel during it, shortly afterward, and later that day.
